newsitem.title: USA: Applied Computer awarded three contracts.
newsitem.headline: Applied Computer awarded three contracts.

text.p: Applied Computer Technology Inc said on Monday it had been awarded contracts by the U.S. Air Force Academy, the U.S. Naval Academy and the U.S. Military Academy to provide computer systems to their entire incoming freshman classes for an estimated $7.5 million.
"This is the first time that all three U.S. services academies selected the same vendor for these contracts," Applied Computer said in a statement.
The estimated value of these contracts represents a 53 percent increase over the $4.9 million freshman class academy contracts awarded to Applied Computer in fiscal 1996, it added.
Applied Computer provides customized information system solutions to businesses, institutions and public organizations.
